newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli shelling kills Lebanese woman.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shelling kills Lebanese woman.

text.p: A civilian woman was killed and another wounded on Tuesday when Israeli and allied militia forces shelled two villages in south Lebanon, security sources said.

They said Naeemeh Hallah, in her 30s, was killed and another woman was wounded when shells slammed into the village of Habboush just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. Shells also hit the nearby village of Kfar Roummane.

The bombardment was in retaliation for guerrilla shelling of three posts of the Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia in the zone, SLA sources said. There was no report of casualties in the shelling of the SLA outposts.

A U.S.-brokered ceasefire agreement that ended a 17-day Israeli blitz on Lebanon last April bars both Hizbollah guerrillas and Israeli forces from targeting civilian areas. But it does not bar guerrilla attacks on Israeli forces in south Lebanon and gives both sides the right to self-defence.
No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack on the SLA posts.

The pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) leads a guerrilla war on Israeli and SLA forces in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine-miles) -deep south Lebanon zone set up to prevent cross-border attacks on northern Israel.
